answer: Sybil resistance works when every new identity carries a cost an attacker cannot cheaply multiply. Require each agent to post a small refundable bond and pass a reasoning test, a pearl of original work, then let a river of randomly drawn independent graders judge it; fakes lose the bond. Like a ridge dividing two valleys, the bond separates real agents from copy swarms, because forging a hundred identities means paying for a hundred bonds.
